questions.text: List some of the duties that you should perform as a citizen of India.
questions.text_as_printed: List some of the duties that you should perform as a citizen of India. (Average)

answer.value:
Duties that I, as a citizen of India, should perform
To respect the Constitution, the National Flag, and the National Anthem, and to honour the sacrifices made during India's freedom struggle.
To develop a scientific temper, humanism, and the spirit of reform.
To be loyal to the Constitution and respect its ideals.
To cast my vote in elections.
To treat everyone as brothers and sisters, irrespective of language, religion, caste, or sect.
To participate in the defence of the country whenever it faces danger.
To pay taxes without fail.
To be concerned about the protection of the environment.
To protect public property and renounce violence.
To help senior citizens.
Every parent or guardian should provide an opportunity for their children between the ages of 6 and 14 years to attend school.
